native_code_context.mathematical_issue: rotation_difference maps its receiver direction onto its argument. Applied actively to a vector, the native quaternion transports target normal toward base normal, the inverse of the required base→target transport.
native_code_context.supported_change: n.rotation_difference(morph_n), same active application and delta subtraction; do not alter normals,UV,positions,w or materials.

UV_direction_method_limits.method: Actual sparse/regularGLB accessors decoded independently withNumPy. Face dP/du,dP/dv derived from actual triangles andUV; unit face derivatives combined with corner-angle weights and projected into the exported normal plane.
UV_direction_method_limits.what_it_checks: Tangential direction relative toUV-U, no180degree reversal; actualw preserved; baseline vs target UV-V polarity separated from patch change.
UV_direction_method_limits.not_claimed: This is an angle-weighted derivative surrogate, not an independently recomputed exactMikkTSpace frame per morphed mesh. Maximum residual angle therefore is a comparison observation, not a Mikk parity pass/tolerance.

source_preservation.independently_confirmed_on_actual_GLBs: Indices, base POSITION/NORMAL/TEXCOORD_0/TANGENT including w, and morph POSITION/NORMAL are numerically identical between archived 50e82d5 and actual patched eeda9976. Only morph TANGENT buffers changed.

handedness_and_runtime_reading.not_a_global_sign_repair: Do not change tangentw merely to make it align with raw exported dP/dV. The negative orientation is already present at base and in both before/after files; the local morph patch does not create it.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.actual_UV_math: For all 154010 vertices in every sampled state, w*cross(N,T) has negative dot with the angle-weighted dP/dV surrogate. UV-U stays aligned; the UV Jacobian determinant is nonzero. Exporter explicitly maps Vsource to 1−Vsource while retaining the native Blender sign.

handedness_and_runtime_reading.runtime_texture_flipY: glTFLoader.pure.js2119 constructs importedtexture with invertY:false. This is upload orientation, distinct from green-channel inversion and fromUVv→1−v.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.provided_tangent_shader_path: bumpVertex.js6 normalises updatedN/T, buildsB=cross(N,T)*w andvTBN. bumpFragment.js14 uses thatvTBN directly whenTANGENT+NORMAL are defined; in that branchinvertX/Y uniforms are not an extra automatic sign correction of the providedTBN.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.missing_tangent_shader_path: bumpFragment.js16 derivescotangent_frame from sampledUV and passesvTangentSpaceParams; bumpFragmentMainFunctions.js67 scales derivativeT/B by those parameters.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.morph_shader_path: morphTargetsVertex.js normalUpdated/tangentUpdated accumulate weighted differences; bumpVertex normalises before buildingTBN. No per-target UV derivative/Mikk rebuild in this path.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.actual_bellows_material: Audited G3 export eeda9976 had one neutral double-sided PBR material and no normalTexture, textures or images. G4 arrived subsequently; see explicit addendum below.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.remaining_G4_reserve: Subsequent G4 source/image/UV orientation is now checked in the addendum. Exact shader photometric parity, NormalMap Strength vs glTF scale and untested morph weights remain reserved; no w/texture sign repair is required by this audit.
handedness_and_runtime_reading.conclusion: The evidence establishes preserved source basis/conventions under the local rotation fix, not a new global UV-handedness/material parity certification.

G4_image_orientation_addendum.method: Read material.py, inspect_material.py and actual embedded PNG; independently regenerated deterministic height/normal field in NumPy and compared top-down PNG row order and channel contents. No render or source/image/buffer write.
G4_image_orientation_addendum.material_authoring: Normal direction = normalise(−dH/du,−dH/dv_source,1); assigned as bottom-up Blender Image.pixels with Non-Color; source NormalMap Strength 0.55.

actual_image_comparison.method: Regenerate deterministic authored float normals independently fromseed/heightformula;comparequantisedRGB withPNGtop-downrows. No source/imagewrites.

G4_image_orientation_addendum.orientation_conclusion: PNG top-down rows are the vertical reversal of the deterministic bottom-up authoring array, with no green-channel inversion. Embedded PNG pixels are identical to authored PNG. This is consistent with exported V=1−Vsource and loader texture invertY=false: corresponding surface points retain source texel contents.
G4_image_orientation_addendum.tangent_basis_conclusion: With supplied TANGENT, Babylon uses the explicit TBN; proper Zup→Yup rotation preserves source N,T and B=w(N×T). Keeping UV, pixel channels and w unchanged therefore preserves the authored source basis. Opposite sign relative to exported dP/dV alone is not a reason to change w.
G4_image_orientation_addendum.source_branch_evidence: materialHelper.functions.js1098–1101 enables NORMAL/TANGENT when mesh data exists and normals are needed; pbrBaseMaterial.pure.js1434 calls it. Fragment uses supplied vTBN when TANGENT and NORMAL are defined.
